_comment: Settings for cluster.py. Each is described in scripts/method.md.
namespaces: vocabulary types whose extension blocks hold unrelated
members (raw C types), so each member is an atom of its own.
promoteMinPlaces: a new type becomes shared vocabulary when code in at
least this many places outside its home depends on it. A place is a
directory under the module, or a file in the module's root.
promote / demote: type paths to promote regardless, or never.
partsForClustersOver: parts of clusters with more declarations than
this are ranked as carve-outs of their own.
weights: the ranking's penalties; see method.md.
